status: Pre-numerical frozen scope. The model protocol and final auditor implementation hashes will be recorded by the audit receipt; this plan deliberately has no circular protocol binding.
independent_algorithms: Do not import the new benefit-cost kernel or new model runner into the auditor implementation. Reuse only the frozen earlier independent100-step scalar self-financing fee bisection and generic accounting helpers, or equivalent separate scalar arithmetic.
Reconstruct quoted post-fee holdings from the actual pretrade holdings and target. Verify current fee equals .0025 times destination purchases, charged once before return, with no terminal fee.

For independently checked forecast states, evaluate both current hold and paid restore followed only by fixed-quantity hold through the original remaining horizon. Keep current CPI, inherited peak, running MDD, original calendar and H.

Compute economic benefit over fixed1-year main or remaining-to-original-H sensitivity horizon, independently verify exact gross-log benefit minus -log1p(-C/W), and separately count both full-original-H MDD events on identical training suffixes.

Replay every saved actual/inner account against original returns with independently computed fees. Reconstruct all actions from recorded economic estimates and integer risk counts after checking their accounting/decomposition identities; independently recompute the forecast itself at the predetermined subset below.

At initial deployment require positive estimated net benefit; mandatory initial restore does not apply the relative risk-direction veto against all bills. Later optional restore requires positive net benefit and restore risk count no greater than hold count. Pending always holds without re-estimation or history reset.

fixed_forecast_subset.population: Every saved selected benefit-cost method tracegroup, both actual and inner validation, including the full120 descriptive context. Hypothetical B/equal reference groups have no economic forecast slots.
fixed_forecast_subset.scenario_rule: Minimum original scenario ID in that group, selected from metadata before forecast values are inspected.
fixed_forecast_subset.skip_rule: An already-pending slot remains pending_skip; a non-admitted method has no saved trace and remains unavailable. No substitute scenario or year is chosen.
fixed_forecast_subset.forecast_scope: All own-training original scenario suffixes at each active selected state; no sampling training support and no test future in action estimation.
fixed_forecast_subset.unit: Repeated actual states from reused original market paths, not independent conditional-probability trials.

fixed_training_policy_witnesses.population: Each of130 jobs and each of2 fixed methods,260 original slots.
fixed_training_policy_witnesses.scenario_rule: Minimum original training scenario ID of that job.
fixed_training_policy_witnesses.scope: Independently replay the complete30-year controller for that one original training path, recomputing the training-law forecast at every active year; compare its path metric to the saved training row.
fixed_training_policy_witnesses.unavailable_rule: Unsupported Q1 case or nonpositive initial benefit stays unavailable with original reason; do not substitute a different path. A training-risk rejection after initial positive gain still has a diagnostic full policy path and must be checked.
fixed_training_policy_witnesses.separation: This is a deterministic numerical witness of in-training behavior; it is not held-out investment evidence.

complete_record_checks: All20160 training metric rows: original job/method/ID membership, availability/NULL, own H/L, finite observed values, growth/CAGR/terminal wealth, breach/MDD/excess and fee-versus-moved identities. All260 summaries recomputed from those rows. This does not independently recreate unrecorded state trees for every training path.

All saved selected actual/inner physical state arrays: holdings, normalized weights, CPI, wealth/peak/MDD/absorbing flag, pending, one-way purchases, paid fees, trades/target execution, first crossing and recovery fields when present.

Every recorded active decision: finite net/gross/current fee quote coherence, training support integer counts and denominator, K/calendar identity, economic/risk booleans and action reason. Every pending decision has declared inactive sentinels and no forecast or trade.

All52 inner gates: recompute each own automatic original-ID set U, risk<=floor(.1|U|+1e-12), and no more breaches than B on exactly the same U and each own inner target. Preserve positive-U prerequisite, NULLs, Review status priority and uniform whole-fit decisions before heldout returns.

All130 Q1 cached components: exact parent/static job membership, effective label, raw-menu product/weights/local-original index and original Review reasons, with cited completed parent static component audits rather than rerunning all172 masks.

All52 final fit admissions: original96/24 repeated or120/120 full-descriptive membership, initial positivity, complete training cap min(kB,floor(.1n+1e-12)), own inner gate, no annual/sensitivity fallback. Full120 results retain in_sample_full120 identity and are excluded from repeated OOF.

cache_and_performance_policy.permitted: Exact deterministic reuse only, with data-array SHA, full unrounded target/state floats, original training ID list/calendar, method/economic horizon and fee/risk constants in the key. Never round a state or merge different training sets.
cache_and_performance_policy.exceedance: If incomplete, preserve receipt and identify unchecked scope; do not silently shrink or replace predetermined checks.

artifact_governance.source_binding: Receipt binds this frozen plan, the executed protocol SHA, the original numerical manifest SHA and final auditor/tests/dependency hashes before and after audit. No successful audit overwrite; failed attempts preserve a separate failure receipt and require an explicit addendum for scope or algorithm changes.
artifact_governance.mutable_implementation_note: The scope is frozen here before model execution; the auditor implementation may be completed afterwards without changing this plan. Implementation fixes and tests do not select a financial policy.

limitations: All unrecorded training policy trees are not independently replayed: one predeclared minimum-ID whole policy witness per job/method and all saved tracegroups are checked, plus complete stored training metric arithmetic.

Forecast arithmetic is independently recomputed at fixed state slots and training witnesses, not every recorded actual/inner state. Remaining decisions are audited against recorded estimates and the frozen gate.

Independent numerical algorithms and source hashes are not independent human peer review, new blind market evidence, conditional forecast calibration, action benefit certainty or full-H risk guarantees.

The training calendar suffix law and fixed-quantity forecast continuation are model assumptions. The implemented repeated gate is adaptive; numerical agreement does not eliminate continuation approximation.
Original120 paths and repeated fits remain dependent evidence; full120 output is descriptive in-sample and cannot rescue a failed primary or replace its missing OOF financial outcomes.
